findings.title: Threshold is per-request only; splitting defeats it
findings.summary: Three requests of 49 were each auto-approved, totalling 147 against a limit of 50. This may be intended — but if it is, it should be written down, because the limit reads as a spend control and behaves as a per-transaction one.
